completion.label: conservative_structural_completion
prompt_translation: Extend unseen regions conservatively using the already visible design language.
Do not introduce new primary motifs or increase ornament density; keep silhouette expansion minimal and functional.
completion.rule: budget percentages are internal heuristics; compile them into visible natural-language constraints.

prompt_translation: Keep the same design density as the visible reference instead of filling newly revealed space with extra decoration.
Do not increase the count of primary ornaments, mechanical modules, chains, tassels, or signature motifs in completed regions.
design_density.note: Relative density budgets are internal heuristics, not measurable vendor controls.

wear.label: clean
wear.rule: Describe wear by visible extent and type. Never escalate the wear state automatically during completion.

human_presence.label: human_presence_v2
prompt_translation: Keep identity geometry unchanged while adding believable facial soft tissue, realistic eyelid and eye-socket structure, regional skin response, subtle natural asymmetry, non-uniform hair grouping, and photographic camera response.
Realism must come from anatomy, material response, and optics rather than larger pores, aging, or stronger sharpening.

regions.forehead: smooth fine texture with restrained sebum reflection
regions.eyelids: thin skin, believable thickness and fold structure, subtle lower-lid volume
regions.nose: slightly stronger specular response with fine texture around alae
regions.inner_cheeks: subtle microtexture and gentle color variation
regions.lips: independent moist material with fine lip lines
regions.jaw_neck: natural soft-tissue transition without razor-sharp contour

camera_rules: face focus is strongest while peripheral cloth may resolve slightly softer
human_presence.rule: v2 human presence changes anatomy presentation and optics while identity geometry and age remain locked.

extremity.label: asset_integrity
hand_requirements: exactly five digits per visible hand
one thumb in anatomically plausible opposition
four fingers with plausible length hierarchy
separate fingers without fusion or duplication
natural joint bends and relaxed spacing
wrist and palm orientation consistent with the pose
foot_requirements: footwear follows the actual foot volume
no duplicated toes or broken shoe-foot intersection when visible
ground contact matches body weight and stance
extremity.repair_policy: If an extremity error occurs while the rest of the asset passes, use a local patch round and lock identity, costume, composition, and lighting.
